title: H-CoT: Hijacking the Chain-of-Thought Safety Reasoning Mechanism to Jailbreak Large Reasoning Models, Including OpenAI o1/o3, DeepSeek-R1, and Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the safety and jailbreak robustness of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) using a new benchmark called 'Malicious-Educator.' While it mentions 'ethical standards' and 'harmful content' in the context of model alignment, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, specific moral reasoning frameworks, or spiritual traditions as a component of the study.
